extension.description: Update Business Central XLF translations from .g.xlf — fast, git-diff friendly
command.merge.title: BC XLF: Update Translation from .g.xlf
command.showSummary.title: BC XLF: Show Last Update Summary
command.setDeepLApiKey.title: BC XLF: Set DeepL API Key
command.clearDeepLApiKey.title: BC XLF: Clear DeepL API Key
config.title: BC XLF Editor
config.defaultStrategy.description: When source text changes: keep the translation (needs-adaptation) or clear it (needs-translation)
config.sortById.description: Sort trans-units by ID alphabetically (stable Git diffs)
config.preserveRemoved.description: Keep removed units as needs-review instead of deleting
config.openDiffAfterMerge.description: Open Git diff after update automatically
config.surgicalMerge.description: Write only changed trans-units (smaller Git diffs). Falls back to full file if a surgical write fails.
config.deeplUseFreeApi.description: Use DeepL api-free.deepl.com (Pro key uses api.deepl.com when off).
config.deeplTargetState.description: Target state set on the trans-unit after a DeepL translation.
config.applyEditsOnSaveOnly.description: In the BC XLF Editor, keep edits in the panel until you save (Ctrl+S); then write them to the XML buffer. When off, each edit updates the buffer immediately.
config.defaultStrategy.enum.keepTranslat: Keep translated target when source changed
config.defaultStrategy.enumDescription.k: Keep the existing translation and mark needs-adaptation (XLIFF Sync style).
config.defaultStrategy.enumDescription.p: Clear the translation and mark needs-translation.
config.findByXliffGeneratorNoteAndSource: Match units by Xliff Generator note + source when the id changed (XLIFF Sync).
config.findByXliffGeneratorAndDeveloperN: Match units by Xliff Generator note + developer note when the id changed.
config.findByXliffGeneratorNote.descript: Match units by Xliff Generator note alone when the id changed.
config.findBySourceAndDeveloperNote.desc: Copy a translation from another unit with the same source + developer note.
config.findBySource.description: Copy a translation from the first unit with the same source text.
config.parseFromDeveloperNote.descriptio: Parse initial translations from developer notes (e.g. de-DE=…|nl-NL=…).
config.parseFromDeveloperNoteOverwrite.d: Always overwrite existing targets with translations parsed from developer notes.
config.parseFromDeveloperNoteSeparator.d: Separator between language entries in developer notes.
config.parseFromDeveloperNoteTrimCharact: Characters trimmed from translations parsed from developer notes.
config.copyFromSourceForSameLanguage.des: Copy source text into target when source-language equals target-language.
config.copyFromSourceForLanguages.descri: Target languages for which translations should be copied from the source text.
config.copyFromSourceOverwrite.descripti: Overwrite existing targets when copying from source.
config.detectSourceTextChanges.descripti: Detect source text changes and mark units for review (needs-adaptation).
config.ignoreLineEndingTypeChanges.descr: Ignore CRLF vs LF differences when comparing source text.
config.missingTranslation.description: Placeholder for missing translations. Use %EMPTY% for an empty string.
config.addNeedsWorkTranslationNote.descr: Add an XLIFF Sync note when a unit is marked needs-adaptation after a source change.
